reason: The README clearly describes a browser automation plugin that controls an existing Chrome or Edge instance over CDP and performs scripted interactions, screenshots, and deterministic visual and page assertions.

summaries.zh: 通过 CDP 控制已运行的 Chrome 或 Edge，执行页面操作、截图以及像素、CSS、DOM 和 JavaScript 检查。
summaries.en: Controls an already-running Chrome or Edge browser over CDP for page interactions, screenshots, and pixel, CSS, DOM, and JavaScript checks.

capabilities: Connects to an already-running Chrome or Edge instance over CDP
Opens or reuses browser tabs and navigates to URLs
Evaluates arbitrary JavaScript in web pages
Captures PNG screenshots and saves them to absolute paths
Runs pixel, CSS, DOM, and JavaScript assertions
